reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V1 = V0 (yaw_rate_pred_rads, which is the canonical KS output with clamp_v_to_measured) minus per-segment gyro bias = mean(V0 - meas) over straight samples (|delta|<0.01), exactly per the agent's run_ladder.py recipe.
notes: Agent shipped V1 on Mach-E only; applied here to both Mach-E and F-150 Lightning. V1 has no fitted coefficients — the 'parameters' are a per-segment bias derived at eval time from each segment's own straight-line samples (>5 required, else bias=0), so the model generalises to any Ford platform mechanically. KS wheelbase L is absorbed into yaw_rate_pred_rads (V0) by construction since V0 was generated with the platform-correct L.
